title: The Original Source and the Dimensions of the Universe
translation_note: Draft English translation prepared with machine assistance for the Phase 1 bilingual prototype. It has NOT been reviewed or approved by a human translator. The Traditional Chinese original is authoritative.

paragraphs.text: You can allow your inner self to settle into stillness, and in the purest way, honestly speak everything that is in your heart, letting go of the bad habits we human beings have always had — the ones drilled into us since childhood: concealing things, saying pleasant-sounding words, and so on. These habits keep covering over our pure and clean hearts. Even though we are kind inside, the words we speak keep covering over that true face, layer after layer. Covered for ten years and then another ten, covered for a lifetime and then another lifetime — this leaves everyone forever unable to attain the freedom of spiritual awakening and enlightenment.

There is no right or wrong in religious faith; the choice is your own. You can choose objectively, because religion has its underlying cosmic logic. In fact, this is precisely a trap deeply rooted in Taiwanese folk belief: no matter which religion you believe in, this folk-inherited faith was originally invented by a few intellectuals who knew how to control the hearts of the people — a method of controlling the populace. Because in ancient times most common people had no schooling, anyone who had studied for ten years was somebody extraordinary! If such a person, for the sake of some interest, gathered scholars together to form a group, passing it down from one to two and onward, it would become a folk religion.

The God I know never interferes with anything in the human world — never does, because He cannot! Let us now discuss how to define “God.” First: humanity lives in the third dimension, and we call any life above the third dimension a god. Such beings are more advanced than we are; they can see what we cannot see and do what we cannot do, so we call them gods. Second: the one and only God. Who is the one and only God? You may call Him the Original Source. He is the origin of everything; everything in the universe comes from this God, which is why we call Him the Original Source — in English, “Original Source,” the most primal origin. That is, the source of everything before the Big Bang; therefore we address Him as the Original Source.

The universe currently has thirteen dimensions (dimension; the fourth dimension is abbreviated 4D, and so on). In terms of cosmic logic, the universe can contain infinitely many dimensions — as long as you can perceive one, it exists. Within the range of what humanity can understand, being able to comprehend the fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh dimensions is already quite remarkable. Through this topic we can look more deeply into Taiwanese folk belief. I just said that gods are beings of the fourth through seventh dimensions and higher. Usually a 4D god is in fact what the classic Chinese chapter novels call an “immortal.” In those novels you can see that such immortals still have to descend to the mortal realm to do certain things — perhaps bringing you a peach — because they still cling to 3D. Like He Xiangu and the others, they still yearn for 3D life, for the people, events, and things of 3D, and so they keep shifting back and forth between 3D and 4D.

Beings that have evolved in the universe to 5D, 6D and above — especially those above 6D — are the true high spiritual beings. A high spiritual being will absolutely never meddle in the affairs of 3D life; they have no interest whatsoever. Would you go meddle in the lives of ants? The gap between them and us is greater than the gap between us and ants! Would you concern yourself with how an earthworm gets by? So the great crowd of gods in folk temples, minding your business all day long — where your dropped ring went? Do you think a high spiritual being has the time, or the composure, to mind your business all day? A god who has cultivated to the fifth, sixth, and seventh dimensions, coming to manage where your dropped ring went? In their eyes humanity is smaller than an ant; unless it is necessary, they will not spend their days looking after you.

Every world has its own rules of survival and its own cosmic logic. Every plane, every dimension, has its own logic and rules of existence, of living, of life. The first rule the Original Source established is this: no living being may intervene in any dimension. If there truly were intervention, the 3D world would have ceased to exist long ago, and the 2D world would not exist either. What is 2D? The world of ants is 2D: as long as an animal can climb a wall without falling, with no concept of three dimensions, walking along a line wherever it goes — that is 2D. Do they not coexist with us in the very same space? Do we intervene in their world? And so the Original Source's first law of the universe: beings of higher dimensions may not intervene in any space of lower-dimensional life. This is the iron law. The logic is simple: if the seventh dimension interfered with the third dimension all day long, would the third dimension not have perished long ago? It would no longer exist.

The Original Source painstakingly built an experiment, and the 3D experimental space is the finest laboratory. The Original Source wished to test how 3D life evolves toward higher dimensions: what processes of evolution must be passed through? For all 3D life, the evolutionary process takes on average eight hundred to one thousand two hundred lifetimes. That is to say, you must, within this space, reincarnate through eight hundred to one thousand two hundred lifetimes. Suppose each lifetime counts as fifty years — is that not forty thousand years in total? That is a very long stretch of time. But in the logic of higher dimensions, time does not exist; and so 3D life keeps reincarnating, carrying out its evolutionary task within the same dimension.

According to my own Higher Self, when 3D life evolves to around the seven-hundredth or eight-hundredth lifetime, they will for the first time come into contact with the existence of the “soul.” This soul is the self, not some other spirit. Only after their own soul has been born for thirty or forty thousand years do they begin to touch what a soul is: “I seem to have some intuition I cannot put into words,” and then they begin to read books, knowledge, or programs of this kind. In other words, the knowledge and evolution accumulated over your lifetimes are enough for you to come into contact with spiritual development and to find the way home; our ultimate purpose is to return home. Where did we human beings come from? Where did life come from? When the Original Source founded the universe, there was no time in His world. Why does time exist? It exists in order to measure space.

So when time does not exist, there is no distance between us. When there is no time, there is no distance in space; the moment time disappears, distance disappears. The most forward-thinking physicists today cannot understand why the phenomenon of quantum entanglement exists. Quantum entanglement is a term of physics — sometimes called quantum weaving. When scientists' research reaches the quantum, it means we are drawing closer and closer to the Original Source. Although scientists have studied the quantum, there are still ninety-eight percent of people in this world who do not know what a quantum is — because they are still in their two-hundredth or three-hundredth lifetime, still at the stage of swimming upstream. The quantum is the simplest unit in the universe, the most fundamental unit with which the Original Source created everything.

Beginning from this unit, we can approach the boundary of God. Every material world of ours is composed of atoms: inside the atom is a nucleus; inside the nucleus a neutron and a proton, with an electron on the outer ring — this whole system we call an atom. All matter in the universe is composed of atoms, without exception: you, me, the table, water — all composed of atoms.

A hundred years ago, scientists discovered a strange phenomenon. Neutrons, protons, and electrons we call quanta, or subatomic particles; particles smaller than the atom we call subatomic, and these subatomic particles we abbreviate as quanta. Today we take an electron out of an atom, then take out another electron — two electrons in all; then another, three electrons in all — as many as you like. As long as these electrons stay together for over twenty minutes, even just over one minute, a phenomenon appears: when I separate these three electrons, placing one on Earth, one on the Moon, and one on Mars — separate them, calling them One, Two, and Three — when electron One spins once to the right, scientists found, electrons Two and Three also spin to the right at the very same moment, with no gap of time whatsoever. This phenomenon is called quantum entanglement.

How did the universe we live in come to be? From the primal chaos it suddenly exploded into the present universe — scientists the world over all acknowledge this. The primal chaos: infinitely many quanta gathered in an infinitely small space, erupting with infinitely great energy. This is called the Big Bang. Everything in the universe that you can hear, see, or cannot see is the same — all of it a product of the Big Bang. From the primal chaos, through the great explosion, the universe became what it is now.

We have just spoken of quantum entanglement: put two quanta together for one minute, and thereafter whatever they do will be alike. Infinitely many quanta were placed together for an infinitely long time; in the instant of the great explosion they were separated — separated by fifty billion light-years, a hundred billion light-years — yet in truth these quanta were all originally together. The oneness that many religions and many spirit-channelers speak of comes precisely from this concept. Scientists are already using the phenomenon of quantum entanglement to invent new technologies of science. In the future we humans will be able to transmit ourselves across great distances: simply decompose and reassemble the quanta of your body, and three seconds later you appear on the Moon — decompose your body's quanta, and by the principle of quantum entanglement recombine them on the Moon, and it is done. So in the original great explosion of the universe, the infinitely many quanta crowded into that infinitely small space all shared the phenomenon of quantum entanglement; after the great explosion, no matter how far you travel, to the very ends of the earth and sea, you will still share the phenomenon of quantum entanglement with all the quanta.

So Jesus descended, proclaiming what God had told him: that you should love universally. Jesus told you that the people beside you are your family, your brothers and sisters — this concept comes from here, from quantum entanglement. This is the first great concept.

The Big Bang produced matter, and all matter is composed of atoms — no exceptions. You look at feces and find it foul, but it is composed of exactly the same atoms as your body; foulness is only your sensation of foulness. Ask a dog whether it knows foulness — the dog finds it fragrant and goes to eat it. The senses of every living being differ. The senses perceive electronic signals; it is only an electronic signal, not the true reality. What is the truth? What is feces composed of? Atoms, still!

Are you any different from your own tongue? All of it comes from these quanta, not exceeding one thread or one hair's breadth. This is the first notion of oneness. There are some religious concepts here, some concepts of the most advanced physical science, and they can be fully demonstrated. There is nothing of theology or metaphysics — not my guessing, not my channeling spirits — no! It is science. But of those who understand, the proportion worldwide is only two percent. In this very instant of understanding, you join that two percent. Why? Because you have already reincarnated eight hundred lifetimes; and so you truly, genuinely understand what oneness means, truly understand why one should love universally — because this is the one family of the Original Source; the infinitely many quanta within it are the Original Source Himself.

We are the small portions divided out, exploded out, of the Original Source Himself. When many people say we are a part of God, this is what they mean — and so this is oneness; this is the great oneness. The great oneness means that all of us burst forth from the very same great explosion. Now for the second, lesser oneness: in the universe we inhabit, scientists estimate its age at roughly 13.5 to 15 billion years. After the great explosion, many nebulae were produced, many galaxies, and many strange and wondrous cosmic structures. Within the nebulae and galaxies are the stars, planets, and moons we know, and a great pile of things we do not know — all produced through the great explosion of the universe.

It is like taking a rice ball and smashing it on the ground: everything that bursts out of the rice ball carries the reincarnation of life. This is what I wrote in my book (editor's note: “A Handwritten Record of the Process of Spiritual Enlightenment,” published by Suncolor Culture) — the reincarnation of the Original Source. Then how do we define life? Forget the definition of life given by our biologists: anything that moves is life; anything that moves is alive! All nebulae are in motion; all galaxies are in motion; all matter is composed of quanta, and all quanta are composed of strings. Why call them strings? Because they move without cease; there is not a single moment when they stop. The smallest unit of the quantum is the string; it is always moving; at no time is it ever still. This has been proven by scientists — proof that in the universe no matter is ever at rest. Therefore we have set down a definition of life: as long as it moves, it is life.

Quanta can roughly be divided into sixty-one kinds, and subdivided further still — fermions, bosons, and so on. Searching to the very end, only recently did we discover the “God particle,” called the Higgs particle — the Higgs boson. Peter Higgs received the Nobel Prize because he predicted the Higgs particle. The Higgs particle is also called the God particle, because scientists have now found that when this Higgs particle appears, it is in fact no longer called a particle — it is called a field. With the appearance of the Higgs field, all the matter of the universe could form; it is the necessary condition for matter to manifest. The necessary condition for all matter to manifest out of quanta is precisely the existence of the Higgs field — the essential quantum that manifests and creates everything is the Higgs field. At first scientists thought it was a particle; it is not a particle, it is a field. What is a field? A field is a space; when it is filled with Higgs particles it is called the Higgs field; it is a field-domain.

Suppose in a space we fill it completely with flowers — we would call this space a flower field. So when this field is filled with Higgs particles, it is called the Higgs field. For the Higgs particle to take effect, it must form into a field; only then does it function — a single particle alone has no effect. When scientists discovered the God particle, they discovered the secret of the creation of matter. How is matter produced? Found by the scientists! The Higgs particle was the last to be found; all the other particles had been found earlier; only it was missing and could not be found. Searched east and west, and in the end we still discovered it — and so, with the last piece filled in, it is called the Grand Unification: without it, matter could not be formed. Once it was discovered, this is called the Grand Unified Theory.

Switzerland has a giant machine, the Large Hadron Collider (abbreviated LHC), whose purpose was precisely to find the Higgs particle. This instrument is the greatest experimental machine in the history of the world, for its length is measured in kilometers; the scientists taking part include the finest physicists of more than a hundred nations — several from Taiwan among them — all for the sake of finding the Higgs boson. After two collisions they tentatively proved they had found it. How did they find it? They separated two quanta, one in the east and one in the west, and began to accelerate them, driving both to nearly the speed of light. Light is the fastest speed in the universe — three hundred thousand kilometers per second. Accelerating the two quanta to near light speed, they made them collide. Of course it would not be only two striking together: many in the east, many in the west — like shotgun blasts fired from either side — there would always be two particles that strike each other. When these two particles collide at nearly the speed of light, what happens? An explosion. The explosion produces fragments — easy to understand: they shatter on impact, because the speed is too great; nothing can withstand collision at such speed. So this quantum — suppose we say it is an electron — when two electrons collide, many fragments of electrons are produced. The scientists discovered a phenomenon: many of the fragments, when finally reassembled, lacked a corner. Gather up all the fragments — how is one corner missing? Where did it go?

We saw the fragments of electrons vanish from 3D. Where did they disappear to? Into 4D and above. So this experiment proved at the same time the existence of a fourth dimension beyond the three dimensions. It should still be here — how could it be gone? Because the collision at great speed produces electricity, produces magnetism — produced in an instant, just like the great explosion; in that kind of great explosion, infinitely many instances of electromagnetism were produced, generating all the dimensions in the universe. Dimension is plane; that is, all planes were produced in an instant. From the microscopic world we can see the macroscopic world; from the small explosion we can see the great explosion. Here something unfindable was produced: a small portion of the fragments could not be found. Where did it go? All the scientists met and brainstormed, and found that it had gone into another dimension.

In this world of ours, matter does not vanish. Nothing in the universe ever disappears: from the very beginning of the great explosion of the universe, everything exists forever and ever, for a whole lifetime and beyond — this is called the law of conservation of matter; “not perishing” means not disappearing. You cannot see it — where has it gone? It has become energy. What is energy? The fourth dimension. For it is the interchange of matter and energy: its material state is gone, it has become energy. Can you see energy? No — it is 4D and above. So this experiment tells us that within the same space there exist different dimensions. Because this was an experiment conducted in 3D space — on a site of twenty-some kilometers in Switzerland — after the collision something vanished; the vanished thing ran off into another dimension. In this way, the Higgs particle and the existence of different dimensions were found at the same time.

When scientists discovered the Higgs particle, they discovered the truth of the creation of the universe, the necessary conditions for creating the universe, and all the dimensions of the universe. So after this news was published, Hawking immediately issued a message saying that the universe has eleven dimensions. Hawking is a scientist of the utmost rigor, true to the facts; he promptly issued the announcement, holding that the universe has eleven dimensions.
